verdict.rationale: Obsidian's own Bases core plugin lets you filter files by their properties. Notes are stored locally and can be used offline, and the Graph view can filter notes by a search term. However, the pack contains no documentation of a vault-wide full-text search with tag or path operators, so only part of the story is evidenced. One community user reports that built-in search works poorly for them, which is anecdotal rather than a concrete documented failure. Missing for 10: documented full-text search across the vault, tag and path filter operators, evidence that search is instant, and independent corroboration of search quality.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can instantly search all my notes with full-text search plus filters on tags, properties, and paths — including offline

citations.quote: Using a base you can view, edit, sort, and filter files and their properties.
